statements:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
	key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR(400) NOT NULL, 
	body_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	response JSONB NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key, method, path)
)

CREATE TABLE settings (
	id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	preferences JSONB NOT NULL, 
	instance_budget_micro BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	maintenance BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	dispatch_disabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE source_assets (
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	byte_size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	page_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE documents (
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tags JSONB NOT NULL, 
	starred BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	lifecycle VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_asset_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	current_source_id VARCHAR(80), 
	source_language VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_asset_id) REFERENCES source_assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE uploads (
	filename TEXT NOT NULL, 
	byte_size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	received_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	chunks JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	source_asset_id VARCHAR(80), 
	job_id VARCHAR(80), 
	error JSONB, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_asset_id) REFERENCES source_assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE editions (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	target_locale VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	current_artifact_id VARCHAR(80), 
	current_draft_id VARCHAR(80), 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	UNIQUE (document_id, target_locale)
)

CREATE TABLE source_drafts (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source JSONB NOT NULL, 
	coverage JSONB NOT NULL, 
	base_revision_id VARCHAR(80), 
	evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES source_assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE source_revisions (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	parent_id VARCHAR(80), 
	metadata_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES source_assets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE publication_events (
	edition_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(80), 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (edition_id, generation), 
	FOREIGN KEY(edition_id) REFERENCES editions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE translation_drafts (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	edition_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	base_revision_id VARCHAR(80), 
	glossary_revision VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	profile JSONB NOT NULL, 
	qa_id VARCHAR(80), 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_revision_id) REFERENCES source_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(edition_id) REFERENCES editions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE translation_revisions (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	edition_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	parent_id VARCHAR(80), 
	snapshot_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	qa_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_revision_id) REFERENCES source_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(edition_id) REFERENCES editions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	document_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	edition_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision_id VARCHAR(80), 
	translation_revision_id VARCHAR(80), 
	template_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	legacy BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(translation_revision_id) REFERENCES translation_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(edition_id) REFERENCES editions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_revision_id) REFERENCES source_revisions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE segment_versions (
	draft_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	block_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_inline JSONB NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	context_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provenance_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES translation_drafts (id), 
	UNIQUE (draft_id, block_id, sequence)
)
